scope: Role, orientation and data-* of the web component in happy-dom and of the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), and their state parity. Rendered thickness is covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.
limitations: React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React PageSurface with ui-page-surface at five sizes ("fails": []).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-06): 2 inset, gap and widths from resolvePage; 3 no border; 4 children own theirs; 5 no control; 6 no curvature; 7 no fill; 8 density leaves it alone; 9 no floating layer; 10 fills to its max width and centres; 11 no focus of its own.
